messages.content: I need flight options from Chicago to Atlanta for a regional leadership meeting Monday, April 13, through Tuesday, April 14. The first session starts at 2:00 p.m. Monday, so I need enough time to get from the airport to the meeting. We should finish around 5:30 Tuesday, but that may shift later.
I’ll compare round trips that arrive by roughly noon Monday and return after 7:00 p.m. Tuesday to leave some ground-time margin. Are both O’Hare and Midway workable, and will you be checking a bag?
Both airports are workable. Carry-on only. The venue has not been confirmed, though it will probably be downtown or in Buckhead.

Two practical combinations stand out. Candidate 1 is a nonstop from O’Hare leaving about 7:10 a.m. Monday and arriving in Atlanta around 10:10 a.m., with a Tuesday return around 8:15 p.m. arriving at O’Hare near 9:30 p.m. It has the best schedule cushion and is currently about $338 round trip in regular economy.

Candidate 2 leaves Midway nonstop around 8:25 a.m. and arrives near 11:20 a.m. The return departs Atlanta around 9:05 p.m. and reaches Midway near 10:10 p.m. It is about $276 round trip, but the Monday arrival leaves less room for traffic or a delayed flight.
Is there anything later than the 8:15 return for the O’Hare option? I don’t want to be watching the clock if the meeting runs over.

There is an O’Hare-bound nonstop at approximately 9:40 p.m., arriving around 10:55 p.m. Pairing it with the 7:10 a.m. outbound brings the round trip to about $361. That gives you roughly three hours after the scheduled finish. The 8:15 p.m. departure gives closer to ninety minutes once travel to the airport and security are considered.
Keep the early O’Hare outbound with the 9:40 return as the leading option. Keep the Midway itinerary as the lower-cost backup. Don’t book either until I know where the meeting is.

Understood. The leading candidate is O’Hare to Atlanta around 7:10 a.m. Monday, returning about 9:40 p.m. Tuesday at roughly $361. The backup is the Midway itinerary around 8:25 a.m. outbound and 9:05 p.m. return at roughly $276. Both are nonstop and carry-on only. Once the venue is confirmed, we can reassess the airport timing and compare nearby hotels before booking.
